entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'd like to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse monitor I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered on December 15th, which was 37 days ago. To proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

It's not a fault, the box is still sealed. It's just that right after it arrived, we had a major family emergency. My father needed an unexpected surgery, so I was spending all my time at the hospital with him. To make things more complicated, my partner's military deployment got moved up suddenly. It's just been a chaotic time and I completely forgot about it.
Oh my, that sounds incredibly stressful. I'm very sorry to hear about your father's surgery, and I certainly hope he is recovering well. Please allow me one moment to check our return policy for you.
Thank you. I was hoping maybe I could get a partial credit or at least a discount code if a full refund isn't possible.
Okay, I've just reviewed our policy details. It looks like you have nothing to worry about. You are well within the return window.
Really? I thought it might be too late.
Not at all. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're only on day 37, I can process a full refund for you right now. No need to negotiate for partial credit.
Wow, that's fantastic. That was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. It's the least we can do after everything you've been through. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file now. Just pack the item up and drop it at any post office.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a much better rest of your day.
